prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Boundary: receiving interface–completed outbound-load release; objectives: accuracy, committed dispatch, safety/inventory compliance; no explicit modes. Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass): authoritative inventory/status/location/eligibility/expected-shipments/work-release; reconciles movements; sends Dispatch Wave Amendment; produces Slot Reservation Receipt (position/validation conditions). Allocations require available positions/access, shipment-count/inspection/door-release checks, dimension/mass/compatibility/retrieval suitability, clearances, restricted-handling approval; exclude conflicts; favor short fast-stock paths. Establishes shipment-window/loading-priorities; plans identity/destination/due-time/staging against capacity/current inventory. Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook): records vehicle/carrier/trailer/arrival; controls access, staging→doors. Drivers obey directions; check windows/review unscheduled arrivals; assign available doors/lanes/crews; avoid obstruction; hold safely pending reassignment. Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay): verifies identifiers/seals/paperwork/expected shipment before unloading authorization; records exceptions before storage; sends Trailer Seal Exception Note; segregates damage; reconciles count/paperwork before unloading completion. Yard personnel notify receiving staff departure-readiness; close receiving after count/status/door-release recording. Acceptance requires valid receipt/safe handling; monitor clearances; pause unsafe/conflicting/faulted work. Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry): measures height/width/length before suitability finalization; checks limits/profile; produces Oversize Load Advisory, never noncompliant-placement authorization. Inbound Pallet Buffer holds accepted pallets. North Aisle Stacker Crane (Juniperwake)/South Aisle Stacker Crane: zoned storage/retrieval, valid targets/access; controlled cross-aisle movement. North sends updated Aisle Occupancy Snapshot; stale reports hold induction. East Transfer Conveyor/West Transfer Conveyor: respective approaches. Conveyor Line Controller (Brasshaven): separate path sequences using status/signals; inspection/identification prerequisite; interlocks reject occupied/unavailable sections; sensors confirm position. Blockage holds upstream; clear paths continue. Accumulation release requires downstream-ready; merges admit one pallet. Produces Transfer Induction Ticket with pallet identifiers/routing; verifies fields; holds duplicates. Fault recovery verifies readiness, preserves committed order. Autonomous Forklift Fleet: authorized tasks/areas. Outbound Dispatch Sorter sequences eligible pallets; Outbound Checkweigh Scale verifies precompletion weight; Shipping Documentation Desk prepares records. Warehouse Operations Supervisor reviews

New part:
S105: Morrowglass issues a Dispatch Wave Amendment when a destination, priority, or load sequence changes after wave preparation has begun.
S106: Outbound Dispatch Sorter receives the Dispatch Wave Amendment and applies its authorized changes to outbound staging.
S107: The sorter preserves committed pallet order unless the amendment explicitly authorizes a change.
S108: Autonomous Forklift Fleet is introduced under the alias Larkspur.
S109: The fleet accepts work only when its vehicle status, assigned operating area, and required travel path are valid.
S110: Each vehicle selects an available task according to dispatch priority, battery condition, and proximity to the pickup point.
S111: Route selection accounts for aisle access, transfer-point readiness, pedestrian controls, and temporary operating restrictions.
S112: Vehicles confirm pallet identity and pickup location before lifting a load.
S113: The fleet limits speed and turning rates to protect pallet stability and maintain safe clearance from warehouse structures.
S114: During outbound preparation, the fleet assembles the data needed to document each completed transfer and its receiving position.
S115: Autonomous Forklift Fleet produces the Forklift Handoff Confirmation after the transfer is complete.
S116: Handoff reporting records the vehicle identifier, pallet identifier, transfer time, and any incomplete or deferred movement.
S117: Fire Alarm Panel produces the Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice when the applicable fire-protection condition is detected.
S118: Vehicles stop or reroute when active safety controls prevent entry to an assigned travel area.
S119: East Transfer Conveyor and West Transfer Conveyor provide designated interfaces for moving pallets between vehicle travel and outbound staging.
S120: Pallet Dimension Scanner measurements support route and handling decisions for loads that exceed standard pallet envelopes.
S121: Outbound Dispatch Sorter verifies that staging positions match the current outbound plan before loading begins.
S122: Shipping Documentation Desk prepares shipment records from the confirmed pallet and destination data.
S123: Warehouse Operations Supervisor reviews delayed tasks, abnormal vehicle stops, and unresolved staging constraints before releasing the next outbound wave.
S124: Warehouse Management System maintains the authoritative task state for pallet movements, inventory status, and operating priorities.
S125: Coordination depends on timely status updates so each operating area can act on current work without duplicating assignments.
S126: Work requests should include a unique task reference, a destination, and any operating constraints needed for safe execution.
S127: Yard Gate Controller validates arriving vehicle information against the active receiving plan before directing a vehicle onward.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
